name: lorcana-mcp
description: Turn a TCGPlayer collection export into a full card database, look up and search cards, check deck legality, price out what a deck costs to finish, and auto-build legal decklists — all from inside Claude.
long_description: lorcana-mcp connects Claude to Disney Lorcana card data and your own collection. Export your collection from TCGPlayer, hand the CSV to Claude, and it comes back enriched with ink cost, stats, keywords, abilities, and format legality, plus a file ready to import into dreamborn.ink. It can also look up or fuzzy-resolve any card, search the whole card pool by any combination of filters, find which characters can sing a given song, check a deck list for curve and tournament legality, tell you what you're missing to finish a deck and roughly what it would cost at current market prices, and assemble a legal curve-balanced decklist for an ink pair or for Format Coconut. All card data comes from public APIs (LorcanaJSON, lorcana-api.com, duels.ink, tcgcsv.com) cached locally for 24 hours — no account, no API key, nothing to configure.

tools.name: enrich_csv
tools.description: Enrich a raw TCGPlayer collection export with ink cost, type, subtypes, stats, inkable flag, keywords, abilities, and format legality; write an enriched CSV and a dreamborn.ink-ready import file.

tools.name: lookup_card
tools.description: Look up a card by its exact name — full stats, ability text, format legality, and image URL.

tools.name: resolve_card
tools.description: Fuzzy-resolve an informal, misspelled, or subtitle-less card name into a confident match or a ranked shortlist.

tools.name: list_printings
tools.description: List every printing of a card (or every card sharing a character name) side by side: set, number(s), cost, stats, rarity, per-format legality, and cheapest market price.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search the whole card pool by color, type, rarity, set, cost range, keyword, ability text, or subtype, with pagination.

tools.name: find_song_synergies
tools.description: Find every character that can sing a given song (or cost threshold), split into Singer-discount picks and plain cost-qualifiers; can flag which you own.

tools.name: filter_collection
tools.description: Filter an enriched collection to the cards legal in a chosen format (core, infinity, core_zh, core_ja, poorcana).

tools.name: audit_csv
tools.description: Compare an enriched collection against live card data and report any stale or wrong fields.

tools.name: analyze_deck
tools.description: Analyze a deck list for ink curve, inkable split, color split, card types, estimated lore per turn, and Core Constructed legality.

tools.name: what_am_i_missing
tools.description: Compare a deck list against your collection — what you own, what's missing or short, and a market-price estimate to complete it.

tools.name: build_deck
tools.description: Assemble a legal, curve-balanced ~60-card decklist for an ink pair or Format Coconut, in collection / ideal / market mode — optionally around a theme (Princess, Detective, a character name) or including not-yet-released preview sets.

tools.name: get_meta
tools.description: Return a hand-maintained Core Constructed metagame snapshot — each two-ink pair's tier, rough share, and style, plus recent tournament results; with event= returns that tournament's full standings and decklists.
